```yaml
name: Weekly UV Lock & Test

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Every Sunday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  lock_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Lock dependencies
        run: uv lock --no-update
        env:
          UV_CACHE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/.uv-cache

      - name: Install dependencies from lock file
        run: uv sync --frozen
        env:
          UV_CACHE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/.uv-cache

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: uvx pytest --junitxml=tests/results.xml --cov=policyengine --cov-report=xml
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: tests/results.xml

      - name: Annotate test results
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        with:
          report_paths: tests/results.xml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml
          coverage-format: cobertura
```
